remarks: Experience turn-key coastal living with DEEDED RIGHTS TO A PRIVATE BEACH on Long Island Sound, shared by only 17 neighboring homes - just a 4-minute walk from your door. Enjoy summer gatherings, sunset barbecues, 4th of July fireworks, kayaking and seasonal shellfishing, a coveted lifestyle few Stamford homes offer. NOT IN A FLOOD ZONE. Renovated in 2019, this 3-bedroom, 3-bath home features a sun-filled open-concept main level with hardwood floors, FIREPLACE, custom built-ins, recessed lighting and a GOURMET KITCHEN with skylights. A MAIN-LEVEL BEDROOM offers flexible one-floor living, while a separate office/sunroom opens to a south-facing DECK, LARGE LEVEL YARD and seasonal Long Island Sound views. Upstairs, the primary suite features cathedral ceilings, skylights, dual closets and a spa-inspired bath. The oversized second bedroom includes a cedar closet. The finished lower level offers versatile GUEST SPACE with bonus room, full bath, game/media area, office/music studio, wine room, laundry and storage. Updates include newer windows, NATURAL GAS furnace and stove hookup, four-head mini-split A/C and heat, whole-house water filtration, Ethernet and smart switches. Set on a level 1/3-acre lot with mature gardens and new landscaping. Minutes to Cummings Park, Cove Island Park, Chelsea Piers and I-95. A rare opportunity to enjoy a private beach lifestyle with all the convenience of Stamford.
